info.name: hermiq-llm-runner
info.summary: Hardened LLM-CLI-runner sidecar that runs vendor LLM CLIs for Hermiq
info.description:
hermiq-llm-runner — optional, hardened LLM-CLI transport ExApp
A network-isolated AppAPI Docker sidecar that runs the actual vendor LLM CLIs (the `claude` CLI, plus the OpenAI and — when a CLI is supplied — Grok CLIs) and executes a single LLM turn on request. It is the "cli" execution-mode backend for Hermiq's chat providers: Hermiq POSTs a fully-assembled turn (system prompt + message history + tool schema) to this ExApp's `POST /run` endpoint, the runner shells out to the matching CLI in non-interactive/print mode with the provider credential injected via the process ENVIRONMENT only, and returns the model's text / tool-call requests / usage.
Tool execution stays in Hermiq's governed engine — this runner is only the LLM transport. Guardrails, per-tool approval, redaction, evals, model-policy, and budgets all remain on Hermiq's side.
Hardening: runs NON-ROOT; egress restricted to the provider API hosts only (api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, api.x.ai) with no general internet; NO mounts of Nextcloud user data or the host filesystem; credentials injected per-call from a 0600 env-file, never on the command line, never persisted. The `/run` endpoint requires the AppAPI shared secret — only Hermiq can call it. See exapp/llm-runner/README.md for the full hardening model and deployment.
info.author: Conduction

variable.name: RUNNER_PORT
variable.description: Port the runner listens on inside the container. AppAPI sets APP_PORT; defaults to 9000.

variable.name: RUNNER_TIMEOUT_MS
variable.description: Hard wall-clock budget for a single CLI invocation. Default: 120000.

variable.name: RUNNER_GROK_BIN
variable.description: Path/name of a Grok CLI the deployer supplies (xAI ships no verified official npm CLI). Leave unset to disable the grok provider.
